top.title: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice
top.summary: OpenAI used GPT‑6 Astra to help prove a candidate non‑perturbative lattice definition of the Standard Model, advancing theoretical physics methods.

top.title: Congress wants to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal
top.summary: U.S. lawmakers seek stricter export rules on AI chips following revelations of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s alleged ties to a Chinese spy, aiming to protect national security.

top.title: An overview of Jensen Huang’s messy days
top.summary: The Verge details Jensen Huang’s resignation and alleged espionage connections, highlighting concerns over Nvidia’s central role in the U.S. AI ecosystem.

top.title: A Push Down the Mountain: Framing Effects and Internal State Interventions on Collusive Behavior in a Long-Horizon LLM Agent
top.summary: An arXiv study examines how framing effects and internal state interventions influence collusive behavior in long‑horizon LLM agents.

top.title: LoRAWeaver: Directional Adapter Routing in LoRA Representation Space
top.summary: Researchers propose LoRAWeaver, a method for directional adapter routing within LoRA representation space to improve modularity of fine‑tuned models.

top.title: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market
top.summary: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi secured $24 million seed funding to develop AI‑enabled image sensors, targeting global markets and reducing system costs.
